decisions.reason: The candidate's existing message-53 MODIFY already captures the accepted solenoid actuation and press-to-open/release-to-stop behavior; the gravity-fed path and absence of retained matcha belong to pour quality and require no additional control-state update.
Placing the solenoid beneath the bowl does not change the existing requirement that seals prevent liquid from leaking into the base.

The candidate's existing message-53 MODIFY already records the accepted rendered appearance, stainless-steel material, and custom fabrication; the pour-path details do not require another design-state update.
The source reconfirms that the spout faces the barista, which is already the candidate's active orientation and therefore causes no state change.
Preventing matcha from remaining in the spout or tubing does not eliminate or alter the requirement that the liquid path be removable or easy to flush between uses.
The candidate's existing message-53 INTRODUCE already records the accepted stainless-steel spout material; the pour-path change adds no further food-contact material requirement.
The accepted dispensing path does not change the existing requirement that the bottom bowl seal prevent liquid from reaching the electronics.
Preserving frothiness during dispensing is distinct from producing smooth, consistently foamed matcha during mixing, so the mixing-output requirement remains unchanged.
The solenoid-based dispensing path does not change the selected standard 120V wall-power source or the deferred battery option.
The accepted mechanism will inform the wiring artifact, but the source does not change the requirement to provide a basic wiring plan or establish a new documentation constraint.
The selected spout and valve will be reflected in implementation and sourcing, but the source does not change the BOM deliverable or the existing off-the-shelf-where-feasible sourcing strategy.
The dispensing-path decision does not alter the selected whisk style, whisk dimensions, powder type, or bowl-capacity constraints.
